scenarios.name: Qualified opportunity enters Pursuit Authorization
scenarios.expectedResult: Qualified opportunity reaches Pursuit Authorization and is not yet pursuit-authorized.
scenarios.actualResult: Queue exposed a Pursuit Authorization gate and the qualified opportunity opened to the decision surface.
scenarios.persistenceVerificationMethod: Local Supabase read model via p1_01a_get_opportunity_v1 and browser surface.
scenarios.auditHistoryVerificationMethod: No pursuit decision expected yet; history panel visible.
scenarios.notes: Opportunity is qualified but not yet pursuit-authorized.

scenarios.name: Approve pursuit
scenarios.expectedResult: Approve pursuit persists after refresh with decision history.
scenarios.actualResult: Approved status persisted as approved; event rows: 1.
scenarios.notes: No bid submission transition was created by the action.

scenarios.name: Hold pending evidence
scenarios.expectedResult: Hold pending evidence persists after refresh without bid submission.
scenarios.actualResult: Hold status persisted as hold_pending_evidence; reason persisted: true; event rows: 1.
scenarios.persistenceVerificationMethod: Queried local opportunities status and reason after refresh.
scenarios.notes: Outcome remains in Pursuit Authorization and does not advance to bid submission.

scenarios.name: Decline pursuit
scenarios.expectedResult: Decline pursuit persists after refresh without downstream transition.
scenarios.actualResult: Declined status persisted as declined; reason persisted: true; event rows: 1.
scenarios.persistenceVerificationMethod: Queried local opportunities status and reason after refresh.
scenarios.notes: Outcome remains terminal for pursuit and does not advance to bid submission, award, or project readiness.

scenarios.name: Auditor/read-only behavior
scenarios.expectedResult: Auditor can inspect and cannot mutate.
scenarios.actualResult: Read-only page rendered with no mutation button.
scenarios.persistenceVerificationMethod: Browser rendered read-only context from local Supabase role.
scenarios.notes: Auditor can inspect without mutation controls.

scenarios.name: Unauthorized or unavailable behavior
scenarios.userRoleContext: Admin not assigned as Pursuit Authority
scenarios.expectedResult: Unavailable user is blocked in UI and server-side RPC.
scenarios.actualResult: Unavailable copy visible: true; approve-recommended copy visible: false; approve button visible: false; RPC result: pursuit_authority_required.
scenarios.persistenceVerificationMethod: Mutation attempted through local RPC as unassigned admin.
scenarios.auditHistoryVerificationMethod: No success event expected or recorded.
scenarios.notes: Pass requires visible unavailable UI, no approve-ready posture, no mutation button, and server-side block.

scenarios.name: Stale/conflict behavior
scenarios.expectedResult: Stale update is blocked with recovery guidance.
scenarios.actualResult: Stale action redirected to conflict recovery; status remained not_started; version is 6.
scenarios.persistenceVerificationMethod: Manually advanced local package version before submitting stale browser form.
scenarios.auditHistoryVerificationMethod: No successful pursuit authorization event expected for stale action.
scenarios.notes: Browser-level stale form submission was exercised.

scenarios.name: Workspace isolation
scenarios.expectedResult: Cross-workspace user cannot access or mutate.
scenarios.actualResult: Cross-workspace page access denied; RPC result: pursuit_authority_required.
scenarios.persistenceVerificationMethod: Mutation attempted through local RPC as Workspace B user.
scenarios.auditHistoryVerificationMethod: No success event expected or recorded.
scenarios.notes: Workspace B browser access is denied and direct RPC mutation is blocked server-side; RPC error text is recorded for review.

scenarios.name: Mobile smoke
scenarios.expectedResult: Mobile surface has no critical clipping or horizontal overflow.
scenarios.actualResult: Mobile surface rendered without checked horizontal overflow or critical clipping.
scenarios.persistenceVerificationMethod: Live local decision surface loaded with authenticated local user.
scenarios.auditHistoryVerificationMethod: No pursuit decision expected for smoke scenario.
scenarios.notes: Checked headline, decision CTA, status chip, and critical decision copy.
